courses.title: Strategic Planning for Finance Leaders
courses.description: By the end of Strategic Planning for Finance Leaders, you'll be able to apply strategic planning confidently in Senior Finance Manager work, with a working sense of where financial statement analysis fits alongside it. The course moves from core strategic planning technique through a few applied exercises, with a lighter look at financial statement analysis woven in throughout.
learning_outcomes: Applying strategic planning to a real Senior Finance Manager scenario
Practicing strategic planning through guided exercises
Getting a working introduction to financial statement analysis
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them

courses.title: Financial Reporting Standards in Practice
courses.description: Financial Reporting Standards in Practice goes beyond the basics of financial reporting standards, for people already working toward a Senior Finance Manager role. Through a handful of applied exercises and more realistic scenarios, you'll build the kind of judgement that only comes with practice, rather than following a fixed recipe. It's built for people who already have some grounding in financial reporting standards and want to go further.
learning_outcomes: Applying financial reporting standards to a real Senior Finance Manager scenario
Practicing financial reporting standards through guided exercises
Building a short financial reporting standards exercise from scratch

alternates.title: Advanced Strategic Planning Techniques
alternates.description: Advanced Strategic Planning Techniques is a focused course on strategic planning for people already working toward a Senior Finance Manager role who want to go further. You'll work through applied exercises that push past the basics and into more realistic scenarios, with less hand-holding than an introductory course. By the end, you should feel noticeably more confident applying strategic planning on your own.
